description_en: Queries the connection duration statistics of authorized users based on specified conditions. Statistics can be collected by daily cumulative duration or by individual session details
description_zh: 查询指定条件下授权用户的桌面连接时长统计，支持按每日累计时长或单次连接明细进行统计
kebab_example: aliyun ecd query-auth-user-connect-duration-list --data-date 2026-06-24 --comparison-operator GreaterThanThreshold --threshold 3600 --user-name alice --is-ad-user true --with-detail true --page-num 1 --page-size 100 --statistic-type Daily --next-token d129c6c0e8c04c8a9f0e2b7c1a3f5e6d --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryAuthUserConnectDurationList

parameters.help_en: The date for the statistics, in the yyyy-MM-dd format. If this parameter is left empty, statistics from the previous day are returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 统计数据的日期，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd。为空时默认统计前一天的数据
parameters.name: data_date

parameters.help_en:
The comparison operator for connection duration. This parameter is used together with Threshold to filter users by a threshold. Valid values:

GreaterThanThreshold: greater than the threshold.
LessThanThreshold: less than the threshold
parameters.help_zh: 连接时长的比较运算符，与 Threshold 配合按阈值筛选用户。GreaterThanThreshold：大于阈值；LessThanThreshold：小于阈值
parameters.name: comparison_operator

parameters.help_en: The connection duration threshold, in seconds. This parameter must be used together with ComparisonOperator
parameters.help_zh: 连接时长阈值，单位为秒，需与 ComparisonOperator 配合使用
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The name of the end user. Fuzzy match is supported. When you use this parameter, you must also specify IsAdUser
parameters.help_zh: 终端用户名称，支持模糊搜索；使用该参数时需同时指定 IsAdUser
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query only Active Directory (AD) users. This parameter is required when UserName or WithDetail is specified
parameters.help_zh: 是否只查询 AD 用户。指定 UserName 或 WithDetail 时必须同时设置该参数
parameters.name: is_ad_user

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to backfill user details such as display name and nickname. This parameter supports both AD users and convenience users. When you use this parameter, you must also specify IsAdUser
parameters.help_zh: 是否回填用户详情（如显示名、昵称等），支持 AD 用户和便捷用户；使用时需同时指定 IsAdUser
parameters.name: with_detail

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1. This parameter takes effect only when statistics are collected by daily cumulative duration (StatisticType=Daily)
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从 1 开始，默认值为 1。仅在按每日累计时长统计（StatisticType=Daily）时生效
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值和最大值均为 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The statistics type. Valid values:

Daily: collects statistics by daily cumulative connection duration. This is the default value.
SingleSession: collects statistics by individual session details
parameters.help_zh:
统计类型。
Daily：按每日累计连接时长统计，为默认值；
SingleSession：按单次连接明细统计
parameters.name: statistic_type

parameters.help_en: The paging token. This parameter is used only when statistics are collected by individual session details (StatisticType=SingleSession). You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询凭证。仅在按单次连接明细统计（StatisticType=SingleSession）时使用；首次查询无需传入，后续传入上一次返回的 NextToken 获取下一页
parameters.name: next_token

AuthUserConnectDurationList.description_en: The connection duration list of authorized users
AuthUserConnectDurationList.description_zh: 授权用户的连接时长列表

ConnectDuration.description_en: The connection duration of the user, in seconds
ConnectDuration.description_zh: 用户的连接时长，单位为秒

ConnectEndTime.description_en: The end time of the connection, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is returned only when statistics are collected by individual session details (StatisticType=SingleSession)
ConnectEndTime.description_zh: 本次连接的结束时间，为 Unix 毫秒时间戳。仅在按单次连接明细统计（StatisticType=SingleSession）时返回

ConnectStartTime.description_en: The start time of the connection, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is returned only when statistics are collected by individual session details (StatisticType=SingleSession)
ConnectStartTime.description_zh: 本次连接的开始时间，为 Unix 毫秒时间戳。仅在按单次连接明细统计（StatisticType=SingleSession）时返回

Description.description_en: The remarks of the user. This parameter is returned only for convenience users when WithDetail is set to true
Description.description_zh: 用户备注，仅便捷用户且 WithDetail=true 时返回

DirectoryType.description_en:
The type of the directory to which the user belongs. Valid values:

1: convenience account.
2: RAM account.
3: AD account.
4: personal edition
DirectoryType.description_zh: 用户所属目录的类型。1：便捷账号；2：RAM 账号；3：AD 账号；4：个人版

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the user. This parameter is returned only for AD users when WithDetail is set to true
DisplayName.description_zh: 用户显示名，仅 AD 用户且 WithDetail=true 时返回

DisplayNameNew.description_en: The new display name of the user. This parameter is returned only for AD users when WithDetail is set to true
DisplayNameNew.description_zh: 用户新版显示名，仅 AD 用户且 WithDetail=true 时返回

NickName.description_en: The nickname of the user. This parameter is returned only for convenience users when WithDetail is set to true
NickName.description_zh: 用户昵称，仅便捷用户且 WithDetail=true 时返回

UserPrincipalName.description_en: The user principal name (UPN). This parameter is returned only for AD users when WithDetail is set to true
UserPrincipalName.description_zh: 用户主体名称（UPN），仅 AD 用户且 WithDetail=true 时返回

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. This parameter is returned when the results span multiple pages. Pass this value as the NextToken in the next request to retrieve the next page. This parameter is returned only when statistics are collected by individual session details
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页查询凭证。当结果超过一页时返回，可作为下一次请求的 NextToken 继续查询。仅在按单次连接明细统计时返回

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the specified conditions
